title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Statement Glossary: Dispute Relief on a Catch-Up Payment
content:
**Dispute relief.** For a catch-up payment on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the dispute relief follows the amount under open billing dispute on the account (the disputed amounts of the account's dispute filings less those of its resolutions and withdrawals), because a payment never needs to be applied to an amount under open billing dispute:

- when an amount is under open billing dispute and the card's minimum payment principal percent of the latest statement balance less that amount, plus the interest and fees of the latest billing period (less fee reversals of that period), is above the card's minimum payment floor, the relief is the latest statement's minimum payment due less that sum rounded half up to the cent and less the latest statement's past-due amount;
- when an amount is under open billing dispute and that sum is not above the floor, the relief is the latest statement's minimum payment due less the smaller of the floor and the reduced balance and less the past-due amount;
- when nothing is under open billing dispute, the relief is zero.

A relief is never below zero.

## Card figures used

| Card | Minimum payment floor (USD) | Minimum payment principal percent |
|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card, Store Card Plus, Store Card Elite | 40.00 | 1.00 |
| Marlowe & Finch Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard, World Elite Mastercard | 35.00 | 1.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical Store Card account: latest statement balance USD 3000.00, interest and fees of the latest period USD 30.00, printed minimum USD 115.00 including a past-due amount of USD 55.00)

| Under open dispute | Reduced balance | Percent part plus interest and fees | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | — | — | zero |
| USD 1000.00 | USD 2000.00 | 20.00 plus 30.00: 50.00, above 40.00 | 115.00 less 50.00 less 55.00: USD 10.00 |
| USD 2500.00 | USD 500.00 | 5.00 plus 30.00: 35.00, not above 40.00 | 115.00 less 40.00 less 55.00: USD 20.00 |
| USD 200.00 | USD 2800.00 | 28.00 plus 30.00: 58.00 | 115.00 less 58.00 less 55.00: USD 2.00 |
